dedupe_keys.name: equilibre national mensuel production consommation brute

description: Equilibre national mensuel production = consommation brute is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Historique national de la réalisation de l’équilibre mensuel production/consommation (GWh) en fonction de la consommation brute, du solde des échanges physiques avec l’étranger et des soutirages dus au pompage. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Production, Consommation. Its keywords are Interconnexion. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
